section: SECTION 1: SCIENTIFIC PURPOSE AND BIOLOGICAL SEMANTICS
question: What were the key technical specifications and outputs of the high-coverage phase conducted by the New York Genome Center (NYGC)?
reference_answer: The NYGC phase utilized Illumina 30X technology to sequence 3,202 samples, outputting GRCh38 realignment and structural variants (SVs).
